_common: The images show the same tiny low-resolution character from a 1996 isometric cyberpunk game, image[1] from the front, image[2] three-quarter front, image[3] from its right side. Redraw this character as one clean, detailed, high-resolution full-body character reference: a single figure seen straight from the front, standing in a relaxed A-pose (arms straight and slightly away from the body, legs straight, feet apart), neutral even lighting, plain white background, no shadow, no text, whole figure visible head to toe. Keep exactly the outfit, colours, materials, silhouette and proportions of the reference; gritty 1990s cyberpunk style, realistic materials, game-ready 3D character reference. Character:
agent: a modernised cyberpunk syndicate cyborg agent, gritty and menacing. Key features: a long black coat reaching the ankles, matte black heavy fabric with subtle quilted horizontal padding across the chest, a tall straight upright stand collar (not folded, no lapels) rising up to the ears; a utility belt with pouches and a metal buckle worn over the coat at the waist; a black fitted mask covering the nose, mouth and chin; blank glowing pale white eyes with no pupils; natural realistic human skin, slightly pale; short dark hair, neatly cut short on the sides; brushed-steel cybernetic shoulder pads, compact, with a few small vents; dark blue-black armoured cybernetic plating on the forearms and boots, with subtle blue glowing seams; black tactical gloves; heavy armoured boots. Stern, emotionless, high-tech corporate assassin, Blade Runner style, no weapon in hand.
police: an armoured future riot police officer in a long dark violet-purple coat-tunic over grey body armour, pale grey metallic helmet covering the head, grey metallic shoulder and arm armour, grey gloves, dark boots, no weapon in hand.
briefcase_m: a corporate businessman with short blond hair, a slate grey-blue jacket with darker horizontal bands across the chest, a dark red belt, dark grey trousers, black shoes, holding a brown leather briefcase in his right hand.
_ref_note: image[4] is the original box art of this agent: follow its coat, collar, belt and mask, but keep the pose, view and the other features described here.
